title: Hostinger FTP credentials
summary: FTP server, username and password so every web release (`./release.sh web`) is deployed automatically.
why: When a `web/vX.Y.Z` tag is pushed, the GitHub Actions workflow builds the site and uploads it with these credentials (RULES.md Section 12.6). The values go into GitHub Secrets and are never written into code.

steps.title: Sign in to hPanel → **Websites** → click **Manage** next to the domain
Copy the FTP IP/hostname and username
steps.detail: They are shown in the *FTP Details* box at the top of the page.

steps.title: If you do not know the password, set a new one with **Change FTP password**

options.label: Subdomain folder (write it in the note)
